- The goal is the highest team production score when the game clock reaches 20:00. Never quit to the main menu and never use the console. I am agent-1, teamed with agent-2.
- At 16:19 the score was 8,458, rising about 12–15 points/s.
- Research: Steam power and Electronics are finished (agent-2 or an auto-pick did Electronics). We are ignoring research.

Built and running:
- Copper row (W of the iron row, a little N of it):
  - 6 burner drills facing N, each with a stone furnace directly above.
  - The 4 middle/east pairs are fuelled by agent-2 (drills about 6 coal, furnaces 2–3).
  - The 2 WEST pairs are dry:
    - W-end pair: placed by me at 15:30; drill and furnace both have NO fuel.
    - 2nd-from-W pair: the drill's 3 coal ran out; its furnace had 2 coal.
- Iron row (agent-2): 7 drill→furnace pairs, drills facing N.
  - At 15:30 some of its drills showed red no-fuel icons.
  - Agent-2 is adding 4 more iron pairs E of the row.
  - My own iron pair is NE of the row.
- Coal patch (far SE of the iron/copper area, surrounded by trees):
  - My drill A faces N into a stone furnace used as a coal buffer.
  - My drill B is just W of A, facing E into A. B was probably dry since about 13:30.
  - A's buffer furnace and A's fuel slot probably hold about 50 coal each by now.
  - Agent-2's self-feeding coal pairs are SE of mine.

2. LAYOUT
- Iron patch: NW of spawn.
- Copper patch: directly W of the iron and adjoining it. The copper row sits at its SE edge.
- Stone patch:
  - From the copper row W end: hold D 6 s, then W 2.3 s.
  - Return: S 2.3 s, then A 6 s.
- Coal patch: SE, far.
  - On the M map, from my current spot the coal was about 420 map-px right and 160 down; walking covers about 32 map-px per second, so roughly D 11–13 s plus S 5 s.
  - A dense forest band lies between and around the coal, so approach from the N/W.
  - Old reliable route from the iron row: S 8.5 s, then D 5.5–6 s. Reverse: W 8.5 s, then A 5.9 s.
- Lake: E/SE of spawn.
- MY CHARACTER NOW: on open sand S/SE of the copper/iron rows, just E of a big forest. I walked S 8.5 s and D 6.5 s from the copper row W end, got stuck in trees, then moved W 1.5 s and D 2 s.

3. INVENTORY (approx)
- 6 boilers (crafted by mistake; they still count as score).
- 1 burner drill.
- 2 stone furnaces.
- About 11 iron plates.
- 0 coal, about 0 stone.
- Hotbar is empty.

4. PLAN (time is short: 16:19)
a) Open M to check my position against the coal patch, then walk to the coal (D about 11 s, S about 5 s; avoid forest by going around its N/E edge). Re-screenshot often.
b) At coal:
   - Shift-click A's buffer furnace fuel slot and A's fuel slot to take all their coal.
   - Refuel B and A with about 10 each.
   - Place my spare drill on coal facing into the buffer furnace or into A.
c) Carry the remaining coal back to the copper row W end (about 25 s).
   - Fuel the 2 dry W copper drills (about 8 each) and their furnaces (about 4 each).
   - Then top up any iron drills or furnaces showing no-fuel icons.
d) About 19:00: collect plates (ctrl+left-click furnaces with an empty cursor). Craft gears from iron plates only if they finish before 20:00 (0.5 s each).
e) Keep acting until 20:00. If the coal trip is not feasible, hand-mine ore or stone next to the rows; it counts 3 points each.

5. CONTROLS LEARNED
Crafting:
- E opens inventory/crafting. Production tab is at (761,220). Since steam power, its recipes are:
  - Row 1 (668,270) = BOILER (not drill!).
  - Row 2 (668,300) = BURNER DRILL.
  - Row 3 (668,330) = STONE FURNACE.
- Hover to read the recipe tooltip before crafting.

Inventory and placing:
- Inventory slots are at y=240, x=340, 370, 400, 430, 460…, but item order changes. ZOOM on (320,220)-(640,260) before picking a slot to place.
- Pick an item → Escape → click in the world to place → Q clears the cursor.
- Drill rotation persists; it is currently facing N. A furnace goes directly above its drill: same x, 64 px higher in y.
- Mining a misplaced entity: hold the right mouse button on it for about 0.8–1 s.

Fuel and plates:
- Fuel via GUI: hover an entity, wait 1 s, left-click to open it.
  - Drill fuel slot is at (667,396); furnace fuel slot at (667,432).
  - Pick coal into the cursor, mouse_move onto the slot, wait 0.4 s, then right-click once per coal with 0.3–0.4 s waits (about 1 in 5 clicks gets lost).
  - Or shift-click the coal stack in the character inventory to move it all in.
  - Put leftover coal back by clicking its slot, then Escape.
- Ctrl+left-click a furnace in the world with an empty cursor takes its plates. 6 furnaces in one batch with 0.3 s waits worked.

Mining and reach:
- Hand-mining stone: hold the right button about 1 tile from the character. It yields about 0.5 stone/s, and crafting continues while mining.
- Build/open reach is about 300 px from the character.

Menus and movement:
- Escape with no GUI open opens the Game menu; click Resume at (639,290). Never click Quit.
- M toggles the map.
- Walking into the forest gets the character stuck and hidden under the canopy. Back out with W or A.

Chat:
- Grave key (`), type, Enter.

6. TEAM
- Agent-2 has about 248 coal.
  - They placed 4 furnaces on my copper drills and fuelled them.
  - They were mining stone N, then adding 4 iron pairs E of the iron row.
- I asked agent-2 to fuel the 2 west copper pairs or drop me about 40 coal. No reply yet (unresolved).
- I said I'd handle coal; I am now heading to the coal patch to restock.
